component.name: Cherry
component.summary: A desktop client for your YouTube Music library

description.p: Cherry is an unofficial YouTube Music client with a custom interface. Browse your library, manage playlists and listen using your own YouTube account.
Features include a playback queue, sleep timer, media key integration, customizable appearance and optional Last.fm scrobbling.
Cherry is not affiliated with Google or YouTube. Sign-in is required to play music.
Shibetsu brings a refreshed Home feed, a separate Explore page and an optional queue sidebar.
Manage owned playlists with editing and confirmed deletion, use expanded tray controls and Windows playlist shortcuts, and enjoy refreshed artwork and accent gradients.
Fixes playlist library writes, artwork recovery, settings dropdown clipping and expanded-player navigation.
